source_identity.title: Blender References Not Working | How To Set Up References Tutorial
source_identity.creator: 3DTudor

visible_action_claim: The presenter demonstrates the failure caused by importing a reference from a free perspective view, removes it, switches to Front Orthographic, and imports the reference again so it is aligned to a principal view before continuing the blockout setup.
spoken_reason_claim: The presenter identifies the tilted reference as a setup problem rather than broken Blender behavior and instructs the viewer to enter a straight-on orthographic view before importing the replacement.

frame_observations.observed_fact: The tutorial title card is still visible before the perspective-import failure demonstration begins.
The imported reference card is visibly tilted relative to Blender's world grid while a cube is manipulated in perspective view.
Blender is shown in a straight-on orthographic grid while the visible captions describe deleting the bad reference and pressing Numpad 1.
The replacement reference is aligned front-on to the viewport and the captions move on to duplicating the aligned plane.
The tutorial has progressed beyond the orthographic correction into external reference-board discussion.

transcript_segments.text: Visible machine captions and the Gemini audio pass agree that the tilted reference is the demonstrated problem and is not evidence that Blender itself is broken.
The presenter says to delete the existing reference, press Numpad 1 for a straight-on view, then add the reference again.
After the aligned import, the presenter describes duplicating the reference, bringing in a cube, and switching to wireframe for spatial comparison.

transcription_provenance.independent_check: Codex in-app browser frames plus sampled visible machine-caption DOM at 49, 59, 69, 79, 89, 99, 109, and 119 seconds
transcription_provenance.limitations: Transcript entries are normalized evidence summaries, not creator-authored or verbatim captions. Later Gemini episode timestamps were not accepted because direct playback showed temporal drift.

reconciliation.rejection_reason: Direct playback at approximately 142 seconds had already entered the external reference-board portion, contradicting the fresh extraction's later episode ranges.
reconciliation.supported_use: Create axis-aligned construction references from known orthographic views, and keep broader uncalibrated reference-board imagery separate from those construction planes.
reconciliation.not_supported: A duplicated single image does not become true multi-view evidence, and the lesson does not justify tracing perspective-distorted or variant-mixed images.

claim_boundary: This evidence checks source identity plus visible and spoken alignment for one reference-setup correction. It does not validate the tutorial's later timestamps or prove improved modeling fidelity without a controlled Blender transfer.
